incidentalPrivateExposure.honestConsequence: For this unit the parent cannot claim that no message bodies were read. Inertness rests on file metadata plus zero active readers, not a fresh body-free proof.
incidentalPrivateExposure.parentDecision: Log and private file left intact. Deletion of evidence of an exposure is not performed unilaterally even under broad gate approval; the user can request removal, which would then also remove the only record of what leaked.
incidentalPrivateExposure.prevention: Future source checks must exclude .session-coordination and other private paths by name rather than relying on gitignore-aware grep flags.
